title: Supplementary material: Artificial Intelligence in Therapeutic Decision-Making in Colorectal Cancer: An Integrative Review
description: Supplementary material for an integrative review (Whittemore & Knafl) on artificial intelligence applied to therapeutic decision-making in colorectal cancer: protocol, search corpus, screening decisions, PRISMA 2020 counts, critical appraisal (MMAT 2018, PROBAST, reduced TRIPOD-AI), and data extraction for 227 included studies. No third-party full texts are included.
